articles.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed for First Time Ever
articles.summary: For the first time in its 100-year history, the world-famous Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. The unprecedented decision by Macy’s and New York City was made after forecasters warned of potentially dangerous storm conditions. [outlet]’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

articles.title: Report: Biden Memoir Flops, Sells Nearly 40x Less in Full Week than Obama did in One Day
articles.summary: Former President Joe Biden's memoir Promise Me, America moved about 21,000 copies in its debut week, compared with more than 800,000 for Barack Obama's memoir in a single day, according to sales figures reported Friday.

articles.title: Kim Jong-un: Nuclear Non-Proliferation 'Has Collapsed,' North Korea Boosting Nuke Capabilities
articles.summary: North Korean state media reported on Thursday that communist dictator Kim Jong-un had spent the prior day overseeing the production of material for nuclear weapons, stating that he emphasized the need for his country to generate more nuclear weapons.

articles.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
articles.summary: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

articles.title: EPA reports 'zero detection of airborne lead' day after Iowa lead azide detonation
articles.summary: The EPA reports zero detection of airborne lead after the detonation of five tons of lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa.

articles.title: Iowa detonation did not increase levels of lead in water, EPA says
articles.summary: The EPA conducted sampling at more than 130 structures in Iowa, including homes, schools, daycare centers and churches.

articles.title: Documentary clip reveals new details on Princess Kate's cancer journey
